meta.description: Anonymous employee reviews of French companies: culture, salaries, management, benefits.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.boundaryMessage: The issue has been reported. You can try again.
error.notFoundMessage: The link may be wrong, or the page has been removed.

serviceError.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again.
serviceError.NETWORK: Can’t reach the server. Check your connection.
serviceError.SERVER_ERROR: Server error. Please try again in a moment.
serviceError.CAPTCHA_FAILED: The bot check failed. Please try again.
serviceError.RATE_LIMITED_REVIEWS: Too many posts in a short time. Try again tomorrow.
serviceError.RATE_LIMITED_COMPANIES: Too many companies added today. Try again tomorrow.
serviceError.PERSONAL_DATA: Remove email addresses and phone numbers: a review must not contain any personal data.
serviceError.BANNED_TERM: Your review contains offensive language. Rephrase it and stick to facts about the company.
serviceError.CONTENT_POLICY: Your review breaks our content rules (threats, hate, violence). Please rephrase it.
serviceError.ALREADY_REVIEWED: You’ve already reviewed this company. You can edit your review.
serviceError.REVIEW_LOCKED: This review was removed by moderators and can no longer be edited.
serviceError.SIRENE_NOT_FOUND: No company found for this SIREN number.
serviceError.SIRENE_UNAVAILABLE: The SIRENE registry isn’t responding. Try again later.
serviceError.SIRENE_RATE_LIMITED: Too many searches, please wait a few seconds.
serviceError.SOLE_PROPRIETOR: Sole proprietorships can’t be added: they correspond to an individual person.
serviceError.REPORT_FAILED: The report failed. Please try again.
serviceError.ACCOUNT_DELETE_FAILED: Account deletion failed. Try again or contact us.
serviceError.AUTH_EMAIL_NOT_CONFIRMED: Please confirm your email address first (link sent by email).
serviceError.AUTH_USER_ALREADY_EXISTS: An account already exists with this email.
serviceError.AUTH_RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
serviceError.AUTH_EMAIL_RATE_LIMITED: Too many emails sent. Please wait a few minutes.
serviceError.AUTH_CAPTCHA_FAILED: The bot check failed. Please try again.

setup.title: Supabase isn’t configured
setup.message: Copy .env.example to .env, fill in the project URL and key, then restart “npx expo start” (see SETUP.md).
